title: Efficient Temporal-aware Matryoshka Adaptation for Temporal Information Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2601.05549v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Retrievers are a key bottleneck in temporal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems: failing to retrieve temporally relevant context can degrade downstream generation, regardless of LLM reasoning. We propose Temporal-aware Matryoshka Representation Learning (TMRL), an efficient method that equips retrievers with temporal-aware Matryoshka embeddings. TMRL leverages the nested structure of Matryoshka embeddings to introduce a temporal subspace, enhancing temporal encoding while preserving general semantic representations. Experiments show that TMRL efficiently adapts diverse standard encoder-only text embedding models, achieving competitive temporal retrieval and temporal RAG performance compared to existing Matryoshka-based adaptation and temporal retrieval methods, while enabling flexible accuracy-efficiency trade-offs.

translated_title: 面向时序信息检索的高效时序感知Matryoshka适配方法
translated_abstract: 检索器是时序检索增强生成（RAG）系统的关键瓶颈：如果未能检索到时序相关的上下文，无论大语言模型的推理能力如何，下游生成质量都会下降。我们提出了时序感知Matryoshka表示学习，这是一种为检索器配备时序感知Matryoshka嵌入的高效方法。TMRL利用Matryoshka嵌入的嵌套结构引入时序子空间，在保持通用语义表示的同时增强时序编码能力。实验表明，TMRL能够高效地适配多种标准的仅编码器文本嵌入模型，在时序检索和时序RAG性能上与现有的基于Matryoshka的适配方法及各类时序检索方法相比具有竞争力，同时支持灵活的精度-效率权衡。
tldr: 提出时序感知Matryoshka表示学习（TMRL），利用Matryoshka嵌入的嵌套结构引入时序子空间，高效地将标准文本嵌入模型适配为时序感知检索器，在时序检索与时序RAG任务上取得有竞争力的性能，并支持灵活的精度-效率权衡。
en_tdlr: TMRL leverages the nested structure of Matryoshka embeddings to introduce a temporal subspace, efficiently adapting standard encoder-only text embedding models into temporally-aware retrievers that achieve competitive temporal retrieval and temporal RAG performance with flexible accuracy-efficiency trade-offs.
